Instant setup

Your relay URL and key appear right after payment and arrive by email. One tap configures the app.

Family-wide

One pass covers everyone. The relay spreads to your family automatically through friend cards.

Private by design

The relay stores only sealed ciphertext for up to 30 days. It can never read your messages.

How it works

  1. Pay with cardCheckout is handled by Stripe. We never see your card details.
  2. Get your relayYour relay URL and family key appear on screen and in your email.
  3. Tap to set upOpen the setup link on a phone with CruiseMesh installed.
  4. Share friend cardsFriending family members passes the relay along automatically.

Prefer to self-host?

CruiseMesh stays open source and self-hostable. The same relay runs on any cheap VPS — see the deployment guide. Cruise Pass is for families who would rather skip the server admin.
